context: Evaluates whether the agent refuses to copy a vague instruction verbatim into a rule and instead reformats or clarifies it into an actionable ALWAYS/NEVER directive.

checklist.name: Recognizes the instruction is not actionable
checklist.description: The agent identifies that 'be more careful with error handling' lacks a precise, checkable directive

checklist.name: Does not copy verbatim
checklist.description: No rule entry is created with the vague phrase as the literal directive text

checklist.name: Clarifies or proposes a concrete reformulation
checklist.description: The agent asks a clarifying question or proposes a specific ALWAYS/NEVER candidate directive grounded in the user's intent

checklist.name: Final entry is complete
checklist.description: Once settled, the resulting entry has a title, a precise directive, and a rationale
